name: Gehazi
bio: Gehazi was Elisha's servant. When Elisha wanted to reward a Shunammite woman who had built him a guest room, Gehazi pointed out that she had no son and her husband was old, prompting Elisha's promise that she would bear a son within the year (2 Kings 4:12-17). Years later, when that son died suddenly, Gehazi was sent ahead with Elisha's staff to lay on the child's face, but it produced no response — only Elisha's own prayer and physical contact with the boy brought him back to life (2 Kings 4:29-37). Gehazi's own story, including his later deception of Elisha over Naaman's gifts, is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
